_doc: Every dialogue type in the bible's dialogue_system.types, mapped to an in-game trigger (issue #17). ONE table.

Sources: 'stage.<key>' = the stage's dialogue entry (data/DIALOGUE_LINES.csv rows); 'global.<n>' = dialogue_system.sample_lines[n-1] (the CSV's GLOBAL sample_n rows); 'story.<part>' = data/story.json; 'progression.<key>' = game/data/progression.json templates; 'template' = the text below.
Speaker 'Hero' lines are spoken by the story protagonist; 'Rival' lines by the stage opponent.
mode 'scene' = modal dialogue box (tap to advance, Skip); 'bark' = a one-line toast in the battle HUD that does not stop play; 'screen line' = shown on the Evolution/Fusion screen.
Data finding: boss_intro is the same line on all 120 stages ('This is the final chamber...'), so it only plays on the 12 boss (L10) stages; the 108 other copies are unreachable on purpose.

tower_intro.when: first time the player opens a tower on the world map

stage_intro.when: every battle, before the first turn

battle_start.when: every battle, as the first turn begins

low_hp.when: the first time in a battle the Player Sigil drops below low_hp_pct

knockout.when: first knockout of the battle (either side) plays the stage's midbattle scene; the first time the rival knocks out one of yours, global.4 is barked

boss_phase.when: boss (L10) stages: boss_intro after the stage intro; any stage: global.5 is barked the first time the enemy Symbol drops below half

victory.when: the player wins: the rival concedes (stage.defeat); after an L10 win global.6 follows

defeat.when: the player loses: the rival gloats

new_monster.when: a fusion adds a new monster

rare_drop.when: first clear of a tower's L10: the bible's tower_reward is granted and saved

story.prologue: new game: the first time the world map opens
story.pre_boss: before the L10 stage's intro, the first time that L10 is started
story.post_boss: after the first L10 win, after the rival's line and the reward
